487,558 kL — all these wines from around the world.
Do you remember where they came from? WineMine helps.

trends.title: Market polarization
trends.desc: Budget daily wines and premium 100k+ KRW bottles both growing. Mid-range is shrinking.

trends.title: Rise of white wine
trends.desc: Overall market down -7.5%, but white wine up +10%. Led by NZ Sauvignon Blanc.

trends.title: MZ generation everyday wine
trends.desc: Home drinking, solo drinking, SNS pairing content. Wine is becoming everyday, not occasional.

trends.title: Convenience store boom
trends.desc: 10,000–20,000 KRW daily wines dominate. Double-digit growth continues.
